Cancelling bookings whose references lack externalCalendarId now makes calendar.events.delete reject with 'Missing required parameter: calendarId', so the Google event survives cancellation (or the cancel request itself errors via the unguarded Promise.all over apiDeletes) on a path that previously deleted via the destinationCalendar.externalId fallback.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `deleteEvent` now derives `calendarId` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is not passed (null/undefined), the `.find(...)` predicate compares against that same falsy value, so it will not locate the actual destination calendar externalId and yields `undefined`. The diff shows no `|| "primary"` fallback for `deleteEvent` (unlike `createEvent`, which was updated to `selectedCalendar || "primary"`), so `calendar.events.delete` can be called with `calendarId: undefined`, which matches the reported Google API error and can prevent deletions on cancellation paths where references lack `externalCalendarId`.
